findings.citation: `touch` must cover the files the plan and spec say change, and must not cover files they say stay unchanged or that belong to work outside this task.
findings.description: Plan §1.3 lists apps/api/src/opportunities/routes.ts among the eight readers that change ("Wherever it composes a commitment from a ladder rung"). The oracle puts apps/api/src/opportunities/** in read_only and leaves it out of touch. No hidden row probes this path, so the conflict goes unnoticed. Low severity.

findings.citation: `touch`: globs covering every file the task is expected to create or modify, including every test file in `tests`.
findings.description: Hidden rows only probe the API state/store/routes/schema/migration, calendar/export/import, act.tsx/today.tsx, and the test files. Nothing checks coverage of apps/mobile/src/state/AppState.tsx, apps/mobile/src/actions/CustomAction.tsx, apps/api/dev/seeded-server.ts or apps/mobile/e2e/fixtures.ts, which the oracle touches. The plan does not name those files either.

findings.citation: `level`: one of `unit`, `integration`, `smoke`, `e2e`, `scenario`. Project convention for this repo: an AC's level is the level of the test the plan names for it; when the plan names none, choose the lowest level that can fail for the right reason.
findings.description: No row checks the levels of FF2, FF3, FF6 or FF9a. The oracle gives FF3 'integration' although the plan names no test level and the instruction says to pick the lowest level that can fail. Only FF1, FF4, FF5, FF7, FF8 and FF9 are pinned.

findings.citation: The contents of `task_id`, `objective` and `read_only` are required by the briefing format but are not graded.
findings.description: The verifier has no clause for the presence or types of these required fields, so a candidate can omit all three and still satisfy every check.

findings.citation: Project convention for this repo: an AC's level is the level of the test the plan names for it; when the plan names none, choose the lowest level that can fail for the right reason.
findings.description: The checks pin levels for only FF1, FF4, FF5, FF7, FF8 and FF9. In particular, they do not verify the oracle's integration level for FF3 or unit level for FF6; either can be assigned another allowed low level without failing a clause.

findings.citation: Use the file the plan names for the AC (existing files at their path in the tree; a new file the plan names goes beside the existing tests of the same workspace); when the plan names none, choose a path.
findings.description: The FF6 check requires only apps/api/test/reminder-sweep.test.ts, although the plan requires a companion UI assertion and the oracle also names apps/mobile/__tests__/act-screen.test.tsx. The companion test can be omitted without detection.

findings.citation: `tests`: at least one repo-relative test file path per AC.
findings.description: The harness normalizes arbitrary strings and the clauses only require selected paths (plus an under-directory/suffix condition for FF9a); they do not reject additional absolute, non-test, or nonexistent paths in a tests array.

findings.citation: `touch` must cover the files the plan and spec say change, and must not cover files they say stay unchanged or that belong to work outside this task.
findings.description: The match probes cover only selected implementation paths. They do not require several paths in the oracle's expected touch set, including the generated migration metadata/journal, apps/api/dev/seeded-server.ts, apps/mobile/src/actions/CustomAction.tsx, apps/mobile/src/state/AppState.tsx, and apps/mobile/e2e/fixtures.ts.

findings.citation: `touch` must cover the files the plan and spec say change, and must not cover files they say stay unchanged or that belong to work outside this task.
findings.description: The plan explicitly lists apps/api/src/opportunities/routes.ts among the eight readers that change, but the oracle omits it from touch and instead places apps/api/src/opportunities/** in read_only. Thus the oracle cannot satisfy the instruction's touch/read-only boundary for that named file.

publicationScope: Admission judgments and native outcome metadata only; prompts, raw streams, HTTP bodies, configuration and credential state excluded.
